product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips GreenSaver Produce Keeper - 4.3 Qt
features: Waste less and save more with OXO GreenSaver Produce Keepers, a complete food storage system designed to keep produce fresher longer
The enhanced carbon filter traps and absorbs ethylene gas, slowing down the aging process and reducing spoilage
The elevated colander lifts produce up and away from the container walls to promote airflow from all sides and prevent rotting
The adjustable vent on top of each Produce Keeper maintains optimum humidity levels for different kinds of produce, keeping them crisp and fresh
The 4.3 qt/4 L capacity is great for heads, bags or boxes of lettuce, broccoli and medium-sized fruits
The enhanced carbon filter lasts 90 days
description: Waste less and save more with the OXO GreenSaver™ Produce Keeper. Storing produce in a plastic bag or crowded crisper limits airflow and enables moisture buildup, creating prime conditions for rotting. Each Produce Keeper uses all-natural, activated Carbon Filters to trap and absorb ethylene, a gas emitted by fruits and vegetables that accelerates the ripening process. Along with the Carbon Filter, the GreenSaver Produce Keeper’s unique construction keeps food fresher longer. A removable basket promotes airflow and prevents moisture buildup by keeping produce away from the bottom and sides of the container. A vent on the lid slides open and closed to optimize the humidity level for the produce being stored. An illustrated guide on the lid shows which fruits and vegetables thrive when humidity is higher (vent closed) and which ones keep best when the humidity is lower (vent open). The 4.3 Qt Produce Keeper is ideal for heads of broccoli, lettuce, cauliflower, peppers, tangerines and more. The GreenSaver Produce Keeper is BPA free and dishwasher safe.
